offering_description.value: Holding company for specialty commercial property and casualty insurers and an annuity business. Sells business insurance coverage through independent agents and brokers, and retirement annuities to individuals, earning premiums, annuity deposits and investment income.

primary_products.value: commercial property and casualty insurance policies; fixed and index annuities; life insurance

primary_services.value: claims management; loss control and risk management services

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses across many industries buying specialty commercial insurance through agents; B2C: individuals buying annuities for retirement savings

end_markets.value: specialty commercial insurance; retirement savings; agriculture; transportation; construction

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums on business policies, annuity deposits and investment income on reserves

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in premiums and annuity deposits, pays claims and benefits to policyholders

geography_served.value: US national: business and individual customers across the United States

specialization.value: diversified: separate businesses: specialty commercial property and casualty insurance, retirement annuities

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent agents and brokers placing commercial policies; partners / resellers: banks and independent marketing organizations selling annuities

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance licensed and regulated by state insurance departments under NAIC and state rules

notes: Business mix and product details are based on general knowledge and may have changed.

P2.15: Sale of long-term care business
